note: Secluded Chequamegon-Nicolet NF campground under tall red pines on the East Fork of the Chippewa River, about 10 minutes southwest of Glidden, with a boat launch and picnic area. No garbage service: pack out trash. The Dead Horse Run ATV/UTV trail is nearby, but ATVs and UTVs are barred in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 249579 read. 7 FCFS sites + 1 group site, no hookups, 2 vault toilets + hand pump, $15, 14-night limit. Not waterfront KEPT (river ~27 m wide, nearest sites ~45-55 m back under red pine). Season written 05-01..10-15 (none stored). max_rig 45 -> 40 (45+ is the group site). OHV side noted.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The East Fork of the Chippewa is ~27 m wide at the campground (under the ~30 m creekside line), and the closest sites by recreation.gov coordinates (3 at 46.0382,-90.7137; 4 at 46.0385,-90.7134) sit ~45-55 m from the bank under continuous red pine canopy. No site on open ground near the water; at most a creekside/view, not worth a value change.
SITES: stored max_rig_ft 45 came from group site 8 ('45+ Foot: 8'); the longest individual site is 6 at 40 ft, so 40 is written (manual).

OHV (flag only, not a drop): recreation.gov markets 'Miles of off-road vehicle on the Dead Horse Run Off-road Vehicle Trail (ATV/UTV)' nearby, but the FS says 'Operation of all ATVs & UTVs are prohibited in campground' and sells it as a canoe/fishing river campground - a general campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp.
SEASON: none stored; written 05-01..10-15 from the FS page. The old note's 'opens ~Thu before May fishing opener' is superseded.

PHONE: stored 715-264-2511 is still the first number recreation.gov lists ('(715) 264-2511 OR (715) 634-4821'); the FS page now lists the Hayward Office 715-638-7243. Keep, or 715-264-2511 -> 715-638-7243 if the FS page should win.

CONTRADICTION (minor): recreation.gov says 'Trash collection and recycling bins are available'; the newer FS page says 'Garbage service is not provided ... pack out what you bring' - the note follows the FS page.
STATUS: 'closed for the season' (boat landing open) - ordinary seasonal closure.
